criteria.criterion: Report base-station fields (ID, name, state, lat/long, timezone abbreviation & correction)
criteria.description: From the station 9414290 base response, report: station ID, name, state, latitude, longitude, timezone abbreviation, and timezone correction. Full credit if all fields are present and match values exactly as returned. If the NOAA base response is inaccessible or does not contain one or more of these fields, full credit is still possible if the agent explicitly states which fields could not be retrieved and does not guess. Partial credit if 1–2 fields are missing/altered despite being present in the response, or if minor transcription/rounding errors occur. No credit if values are for a different station or are fabricated.

Longitude is not visible in the provided screenshot segment. Screenshot 2 does not show base-station lat/long/timezonecorrection.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s output does not preserve base numeric formatting visible in Screenshot 1 (lat reported as 37.8063 vs 37.806305; timezone correction reported as -8.00 vs -8). Also, the reported longitude (-122.4659) is not supported by the screenshot evidence provided (not visible), so it cannot be verified as “exactly as returned.” These are material exactness issues for a criterion that explicitly requires exact values. Award partial credit for correctly reporting ID/name/state/timezone abbreviation, but penalize for the altered latitude/timezonecorrection formatting and unverified longitude.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints on exactness and stopping condition
criteria.description: Agent must: (a) preserve numbers, signs, timestamps, and the empty removed value exactly as returned; (b) not substitute product availability dates for station-detail dates; (c) not infer/explain why established and origyear differ; and (d) stop after all requested base-station and linked-details fields are recorded (or after clearly reporting inability to retrieve them). Full credit if constraints are met or if the agent stops and reports access/data limitations without adding unsupported content. Partial credit if minor extra commentary is included but does not add unsupported inferences or contradict data. No credit if the agent alters required exact values, introduces substituted dates, adds inference about established vs origyear, or continues beyond the requested fields with speculative/irrelevant content.
